messages:
incident-bot: PAGING <@maya> — p99 spike detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (streaming). Automated alert: latency_slo_breach (p99 > 1.5s). Routing anomalies flagged by router-health-check (score 0.73).

maya (oncall): seeing it, joining. what’s the breadth?

lisa (sre): p95 elevated too but p99 is worst. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/intersvc/d/latency/usw2?var=route=/v1/generate

jonah (runtime): quick summary from sampling: ~12% of requests hitting long tail, most have backend_time ~1200-2200ms. KV cache hit rates normal.

sam (infra): any recent changes to routing or LB policies in the last 30m? I see a weight tweak pushed by rollout-bot at 2001234200 for ingress-split-policy.

maya (oncall): @sam please paste the rollout diff. we should check for skews or config leak.

sam (infra): patch from rollout-bot: 
```
- ingress-split-policy: {usw2: 0.7, useast1: 0.3}
+ ingress-split-policy: {usw2: 0.55, useast1: 0.45}
```
rolled by auto-canary 20m ago.

jonah (runtime): that expands cross-zone routing for some request classes. interestingly the traces show requests being routed to a remote shard in useast1 that had high queue_time.

lisa (sre): correlation: router misroute count spiked at the same time as the rollout. p99 for locally-routed requests stable, remote-routed p99 >>.

maya (oncall): customer impact? any 5xxs or just latency?

support-bot: Alert cross-ref: 14 support tickets opened in last 15m referencing slow responses for Chat API, top customers: corp-a (prod), corp-b (staging). No increase in error rate.

maya (oncall): OK — latency-only. mitigation plan options: 1) revert rollout, 2) pin ingress-split-policy to local-only for latency-sensitive routes, 3) enable eager-fallback to local shard for streaming. Thoughts?

jonah (runtime): can enable eager-fallback for streaming routes quickly via router flag flip (no deployment). command: `curl -XPOST http://router-config/api/flags -d '{\"eager_fallback_streaming\":true}'`

sam (infra): rollback is available but takes ~5m to propagate across LB. flag flip is faster. we should also consider reducing weight to useast1 to 0 for sensitive routes.

lisa (sre): short-term: enable eager-fallback + reduce useast1 weight for /v1/generate to 0.1. medium-term: revert rollout if metrics not improving in 10m.

maya (oncall): go for flag flip + weight tweak. sam, can you do weight tweak? jonah, flip flag?

sam (infra): on it. running: 
```
POST /router-config/policy/update
{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":{"useast1":0.1,"usw2":0.9}}
```
applied at 2001234475.

jonah (runtime): flipping flag now.
```
curl -s -XPOST http://router-config/api/flags -d '{\"eager_fallback_streaming\":true}' && echo done
```
returned done at 2001234481.

maya (oncall): monitoring p99 now.

lisa (sre): short-term graphs: p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 1.1s in 45s. p95 ~ stable. number of long-tail traces routing to useast1 dropped significantly.

support-bot: CS update queue: Draft message suggested — "We observed elevated API latency in us-west-2 for some streaming requests. We’ve applied mitigations and are monitoring. No data loss; degraded latency briefly." Shall I send to affected customers after we stabilize?

maya (oncall): hold off until p99 < 1.0s for 5m.

sam (infra): rolling back the ingress rollout entirely as a precaution (staged rollback). executing: `rollout cancel ingress-split-policy/2026-03-14`

jonah (runtime): note: logs show a small hotkey set causing backend queueing on a subset of shards — some routes had concentrated traffic for a new internal feature. that + weight shift amplified tail.

lisa (sre): can we identify the hot key(s)? jonah, can you export top keys from router traces?

jonah (runtime): export running. top hotkeys: [\"session:chat:prod:corp-a\" ~ 9% of requests], [\"prompt:embed:internal-test\" ~ 6%].

maya (oncall): escalate to platform team to add hotkey leakage backpressure if needed. tagged @sam and @jonah.

sam (infra): rollback in progress; second stage at 2001234520.

lisa (sre): alerting: adding temporary paging threshold for p99 > 1.2s for next 1h to catch regressions.

maya (oncall): p99 currently 0.95s and trending down. support-bot please queue CS message to be ready.

support-bot: queued message drafted; will send when authorized.

sam (infra): rollback completed at 2001234550, ingress-split-policy restored to previous weights.

jonah (runtime): long-tail traces reduced to baseline. backlog cleared on affected shards.

lisa (sre): customer impact estimate: ~2.1% of total USW2 production requests had >1.5s p99 during the 12m window, peak lasting ~6m. top affected tenants: corp-a (heavy stream chat), corp-c (low-volume but sensitive).

maya (oncall): action items: 
- postmortem (owner: lisa) — include rollout gating & quick rollback playbook
- hotkey mitigation (owner: jonah) — add dynamic backpressure and improved detection
- policy rollout change (owner: sam) — tighten canary & add simulated tail tests
- CS communication (owner: maya) — send client notice after review

lisa (sre): I’ll start the postmortem doc and tag leads.

maya (oncall): thanks team. closing incident channel once CS note sent and p99 stable for 10m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation applied). Root cause suspected: ingress-split-policy weight change combined with hot partitioning of a small set of tenant keys causing remote-shard queueing and increased tail. Postmortem scheduled.
